readme:
# Douyin Video Search Filter Options API

Look up supported filter options for Douyin video search queries. This endpoint requires no parameters and returns valid criteria compatible with `fetch_item_query`.

## Use cases

- Retrieve valid filter criteria for Douyin video searches.
- Populate filter dropdowns and selections in video search interfaces.
- Validate video search arguments against accepted platform values.

## Request

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/douyin/index/item-filter-options" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{}'
```

## Notes

- Provides filter criteria designed for use with the `fetch_item_query` video search endpoint.

## Pricing

Flat price per call. Failed calls, including lookups whose target does not exist, are not charged.

## Related APIs

- [Douyin Index Area List](/apis/douyin/index/all-area): Returns the complete list of supported geographic areas available for Douyin Index queries.
- [Douyin Index Valid Dates](/apis/douyin/index/all-valid-date): Returns the latest valid dates available for each data type in Douyin Index.
- [Douyin Brand Popularity Cycles](/apis/douyin/index/brand-cycles): Returns periodic brand popularity and cycle analysis data across platforms for a specified brand name and date range.
